source.text: tantrasāra, daśamam āhnikam uktas tāvat tattvādhvā // abhts_10.1 kalādyadhvā tu nirūpyate tatra yathā bhuvaneṣu anugāmi kiṃcid rūpaṃ tattvam ity uktam tathā tattveṣu vargaśo yat anugāmi rūpaṃ tat kalā ekarūpakalanāsahiṣṇutvāt // abhts_10.2 tad yathā pṛthivyāṃ nivṛttiḥ nivartate yatas tattvasarga iti // abhts_10.3 jalādipradhānānte varge pratiṣṭhā kāraṇatayāpyāyanapūraṇakāritvāt // abhts_10.4 pumādimāyānte vidyā vedyatirobhāve saṃvidādhikyāt // abhts_10.5 śuddhavidyādiśaktyante śāntā kañcukataraṃgopaśamāt // abhts_10.6 etad eva aṇḍacatuṣṭayaṃ pārthivaprākṛtamāyīyaśāktābhidham // abhts_10.7 pṛthivyādiśaktīnām atra avasthānena śaktitattve yāvat parasparśo vidyate sparśasya ca sapratighatvam iti tāvati yuktam aṇḍatvam // abhts_10.8 śivatattve śāntātītā tasyopadeśabhāvanārcādau kalyamānatvāt // abhts_10.9 svatantraṃ tu paraṃ tattvaṃ tatrāpi yat aprameyaṃ tat kalātītam // abhts_10.10 evaṃ pañcaiva kalāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvāni // abhts_10.11 tathāhi prameyatvaṃ dvidhā sthūlasūkṣmatvena iti daśa // abhts_10.12 karaṇatvaṃ dvidhā śuddhaṃ kartṛtāsparśi ca iti daśa // abhts_10.13 karaṇatopasarjanakartṛbhāvasphuṭatvāt pañca śuddhakartṛbhāvāt pañca vigalitavibhāgatayā vikāsonmukhatve pañca sarvāvacchedaśūnyaṃ śivatattvaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśam // abhts_10.14 tad yadā upadiśyate bhāvyate vā yat tatpratiṣṭhāpadam tat saptatriṃśam tasminn api bhāvyamāne aṣṭātriṃśam na ca anavasthā tasya bhāvyamānasya anavacchinnasvātantryayogino vedyīkaraṇe saptatriṃśa eva paryavasānāt ṣaṭtriṃśaṃ tu sarvatattvottīrṇatayā saṃbhāvyāvacchedam iti pañcakalāvidhiḥ // abhts_10.15 vijñānākalaparyantam ātmakalā īśāntaṃ vidyākalā śiṣṭaṃ śivakalā iti tritattvavidhiḥ // abhts_10.16 evaṃ navatattvādy api ūhayet iti // abhts_10.17 meyāṃśagāmī sthūlasūkṣmapararūpatvāt trividho bhuvanatattvakalātmādhvabhedaḥ mātṛviśrāntyā tathaiva trividhaḥ tatra pramāṇatāyāṃ padādhvā pramāṇasyaiva kṣobhataraṃgaśāmyattāyāṃ mantrādhvā tatpraśame pūrṇapramātṛtāyāṃ varṇādhvā sa eva ca asau tāvati viśrāntyā labdhasvarūpo bhavati iti ekasyaiva ṣaḍvidhatvaṃ yuktam // abhts_10.18

l1_text:
## tsa10-p01
Stated so far is principle-course. (10.1) But digit-course is described: therein, as in worlds whatever following form is principle, so it was stated — so in principles, class-wise whatever following form — that is digit — since unable to bear one-form grasping. (10.2) Namely: in earth is cessation — since creation turns back. (10.3) In water-to-chief-end class is establishment, through causing nourishing-filling as cause. (10.4) In person-to-Māyā-end is knowledge, in knowable-concealment through consciousness-excess. (10.5) In pure-knowledge-to-power-end is tranquil, from cover-wave-calming. (10.6) This itself is the four eggs, named earthy, natural, Māyā-made, powered. (10.7) Since of earth-to-power principles here, through abiding, in power-principle as far as mutual touch is found — and of touch there is with-impacts — so far egghood is proper. (10.8) In Śiva-principle is beyond-tranquil; of it, through teaching-contemplation-worship-and-the-rest, being grasped. (10.9) Autonomous is the supreme principle; therein too whatever is immeasurable — that is beyond-digit. (10.10) Thus are five alone digits, thirty-six principles. (10.11) As: knowableness twofold, through gross-subtle-ness — hence ten. (10.12) Instrument-ness twofold — pure and agentness-touching — hence ten. (10.13) Through instrument-subordinated-agentness-manifestness, five; from pure-agentness, five; through melted-divisionness in blooming-facedness, five; all-limitation-void Śiva-principle thirty-sixth. (10.14) That, when taught or contemplated — whatever is its establishment-seat — that is thirty-seventh; in it too being contemplated is thirty-eighth. Nor is there regress: of it being contemplated — of unlimited-autonomy-endowed — in making-knowable, in thirty-seventh alone is ending; but thirty-sixth, through all-principle-transcended-ness, conceivable-limited — thus is the five-digit-course. (10.15) Up to knowledge-bodiless-end is self-digit; to Lord-end is knowledge-digit; the rest is Śiva-digit — thus is the three-principle-course. (10.16) Thus nine-principle-and-the-rest too one should infer. (10.17) Measure-portion-going, through gross-subtle-supreme-formed-ness, is threefold — world-principle-digit-self-course-difference; through measurer-rest likewise threefold. Therein: in measureness is word-course; of measure itself in agitation-wave-calming-ness is mantra-course; on its calming... (10.18, close: full positions per T1 tail.)

## tsa10-p01 — digits, eggs, and the courses of word and mantra
Principle-course: done. Digit-course: as a shape running through worlds makes a principle, a shape running through principle-classes makes a digit — what no single grasp can hold. Earth holds cessation, turning creation back. Water-to-chief holds establishment, feeding and filling as cause. Person-to-Māyā holds knowing, excess awareness in hidden knowables. Pure-knowing-to-power holds the tranquil, covers' waves gone down. Four eggs: earthen, natural, Māyā-made, power-made — "egg" holding just so far as things touch with impact into power's own principle. In Śiva's principle: past-the-tranquil, grasped through teaching, seeing, worship. Past that, the supreme is free; whatever in it no measure holds is past digits. Five digits, thirty-six principles: knowables gross-and-subtle make ten; instruments pure and agent-touching make ten; agents under instruments, five; agents pure, five; divisions melted into blooming, five; void of every bound, Śiva thirty-sixth. Teach or contemplate it, and where it stands is thirty-seventh; contemplate there, thirty-eighth — no regress, since contemplating the boundlessly free ends, as made-knowable, at thirty-seven, while thirty-six stays the bound you conceive by going past everything. To knowledge-bodiless: self's digit; to the Lord: knowing's digit; past that: Śiva's — three principles; nine and the rest likewise. Going by measures runs threefold, gross, subtle, supreme — worlds, principles, digits, selves differing — and by the measurer's rest threefold too: measured, the word-course; the measure's waves calming, the mantra-course; calmed... (close per source).

The passage moves in seven steps. (1) Principle-course done; digit-course: shape running through principle-classes = digit (can't bear one-form grasping). (2) Four eggs (earth→cessation; water→chief→establishment; person→Māyā→knowledge; pure-knowing→power→tranquil) + egg-rule (mutual touch with impacts). (3) In Śiva-principle: beyond-tranquil (grasped via teaching/contemplation/worship); supreme free; immeasurable = beyond-digit. (4) Five digits, 36 principles: knowables gross/subtle = 10; instruments pure/agent-touching = 10; agents under instruments = 5; agents pure = 5; melted-division blooming = 5; Śiva 36th. (5) 37/38 anti-regress: taught/contemplated establishment-seat = 37th; contemplated therein = 38th; no regress (contemplated unlimited-autonomy making-knowable ends at 37; 36th conceivable-limited as all-transcended). (6) Three-principle course (self/knowledge/Śiva digit); nine likewise. (7) Measure-portion-going threefold (gross/subtle/supreme) = world/principle/digit/self course-difference; measurer-rest threefold: word-course (measureness) / mantra-course (agitation-wave-calming) / calming (close per source).
